comparison.objective: Tip a block over successive edges until its red face is up, versus finish four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled toppling and reorientation through edge pivots versus precision alignment, bimanual impact delivery, and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Red face ends upward versus four valid tang fractures, complete containment, no damage, and stable final release.
comparison.reason: Edge-pivot reorientation and damage-sensitive notch fracture are meaningfully different tested abilities. No tipping rubric thresholds are provided.
